uptime.auto: This view refreshes every 15 seconds while active. Saved endpoint checks continue when the window is closed.

health.hint: The summary covers the host, reported services and enabled endpoints. It describes observed checks, not every aspect of server health.
health.limited: Coverage is incomplete: data may be unavailable, stale, simulated or awaiting a check.

host.title: Host uptime
host.permission: Host uptime needs system:metrics.read and a role allowed to read system data.

endpoints.title: Endpoint availability
endpoints.scope: Counts cover enabled endpoints owned by this app. Checks from HTTP Monitor are separate.
endpoints.method: Checks use GET, follow policy-approved redirects and always verify TLS certificates.

services.title: Reported services
services.hint: Read-only current state. This snapshot does not reconstruct service incident history.
services.permission: Service state needs system:services.read and a role allowed to read services.
services.name: Service

incidents.title: Incident observations
incidents.hint: Up to 100 observed failure, policy-block and first-success transitions in loaded checks. These are check observations; the configured consecutive-failure threshold determines the monitor state.
incidents.partial: Earlier checks are outside the loaded history; the failure may have started earlier.
incidents.empty: No incident transitions in the loaded history.

health.name: Uptime overview
health.description: Host uptime and observed endpoint and service health.

form.name: Name
form.tlsWarning: Untrusted certificates will be accepted for this monitor.
form.discardText: Unsaved monitor settings will be lost.
form.policy: An administrator must allow the target and port in the App Store. Checks continue while this app is closed.

monitor.background: EveryOS checks saved monitors in the background. This window refreshes every 30 seconds.
monitor.permission: This app has no outbound network permission. An administrator can grant it in the App Store.
monitor.emptyHint: Create a monitor for an approved HTTP endpoint to start collecting checks.
monitor.deleteText: Delete {{name}} and its check history? This cannot be undone.
monitor.schedule: Every {{seconds}} s · Expected {{min}}–{{max}} · Down after {{failures}} consecutive failures
monitor.notifyOn: Failure and recovery notifications are enabled, unless this app is muted in notification settings.
monitor.notifyOff: Notifications are turned off for this monitor.
monitor.notifyMissing: Notifications need the notifications:send permission. An administrator can grant it in the App Store.

history.title: Check history
history.limit: {{count}} checks · Up to 5,000 checks, retained for 30 days. Rates count checks, not elapsed time.

validation.name: Enter a name of 1–80 characters.
validation.url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials or a fragment.
validation.interval: Use a whole interval from 60 to 86,400 seconds.
validation.timeout: Use a whole timeout from 1,000 to 30,000 milliseconds.
validation.status: Use status codes from 100 to 599, with minimum no greater than maximum.
validation.keyword: Use at most 200 characters. Body text is available only with GET.

source.simulatedHint: These values are simulated by the development host and do not describe the real host.
